projection.storage: 44 little-endian float32 columns plus native uint32 track IDs; nonfinite cells retained as NaN, no fabricated observations

partition.grouping: Whole connected native primary-artist and known native album components, augmented by exact full native feature-cell duplicate groups
partition.hash: SHA256(revision + NUL + decimal canonical_group_id), whole digest interpreted big endian modulo 1000
partition.missing_unresolved_artist: excluded with source-positive and feature-row counts; never substitute track ID as artist
partition.revision_reason: Independent pre-result audit found 776 albums crossing initial artist-only folds; revised before any metric inspection. This establishes declared native-ID isolation, not complete recording or performer independence.

model.normalization: mean/std fitted on complete finite training feature rows only; constant dimensions omitted
model.query_missingness: abstain if any active feature is nonfinite
model.query_range_gate: abstain if any active standardized absolute descriptor exceeds 12
model.target: source-observed native track genre IDs only; never factual artist genres
model.scorer: positive-only label-conditioned diagonal Gaussian log density plus log training label prevalence
comparators: constant ascending native genre ID order

metrics: mean reciprocal rank of first observed positive
evaluation.rare: labels with <= 100 source-positive training tracks; preserve unseen and below-model-support labels in denominators
evaluation.abstentions: zero recovered positives while retaining every held-out labeled query and target
evaluation.coverage: raw metadata, feature intersection, label vocabulary, missing/unresolved identities, unlabeled queries, component sizes and realized folds reported separately
